info.name: GharMB - Complete API Suite (Roles, Moderation & Workflows)
info.description:
Complete Postman API Collection for GharMB Platform.
Includes:
- Owner, Agent/Broker, Developer/Builder & Admin Auth
- RERA Document & Profile Verification
- Upload Guards (Blocked until Admin Approval)
- 5-Step Property & Project Uploads
- Admin Moderation & Approval Flow
- Public Filtered GET APIs
